notes.winRate: Wins divided by wins plus losses; ties are tracked but excluded from win-rate denominator.
notes.metricEligibility: Metric calculations exclude standings where the player dropped on game 1.
notes.usagePercent: Team composition count divided by player records with public teams in this stats file scope.
notes.separateMegas: Pokemon holding a real mega stone are reported as their matching Mega species in this file.
notes.comboLimit: Only the top 200 compositions for each team size are written.
